CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_customer_tag_unique(p_shop_id uuid, p_user_id text, p_tag text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.customer_profiles
  SET tags = tags || jsonb_build_array(p_tag),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE shop_id = p_shop_id AND user_id = p_user_id
    AND NOT (tags @> jsonb_build_array(p_tag));
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_shop_id uuid, p_user_id text, p_tag text
functions.name: add_customer_tag_unique

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_customer_note(p_shop_id uuid, p_user_id text, p_note text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.customer_profiles
  SET notes = (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT elem FROM jsonb_array_elements(
        notes || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('text', p_note, 'created_at', now()))
      ) AS elem
      ORDER BY (elem->>'created_at') DESC
      LIMIT 50
    ) t
  ),
  updated_at = now()
  WHERE shop_id = p_shop_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: append_customer_note

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_addon_credit(p_shop_id uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id UUID;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.shop_addon_credits
  SET remaining = remaining - 1
  WHERE id = (
    SELECT id FROM public.shop_addon_credits
    WHERE shop_id = p_shop_id AND kind = p_kind AND remaining > 0 AND expires_at > now()
    ORDER BY expires_at
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  RETURN v_id IS NOT NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_shop_billing_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(auth.role(), '') IN ('authenticated', 'anon') AND (
       NEW.plan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.plan
    OR NEW.plan_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.plan_key
    OR NEW.plan_expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.plan_expires_at
    OR NEW.trial_expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.trial_expires_at
    OR NEW.subscription_provider IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subscription_provider
    OR NEW.subscription_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subscription_id
    OR NEW.subscription_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subscription_status
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Billing fields can only be changed by the billing system' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: guard_shop_billing_columns
guard_user_privilege_columns

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, name, role)
  VALUES (new.id, new.email, new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 'admin')
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id;
  RETURN new;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_botify_knowledge(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, workspace_id uuid, content text, metadata jsonb, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  RETURN query
  SELECT
    id,
    workspace_id,
    content,
    metadata,
    1 - (botify_knowledge_base.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  FROM botify_knowledge_base
  WHERE metadata @> filter
  ORDER BY botify_knowledge_base.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$
functions.args: query_embedding vector, match_count integer, filter jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_knowledge_chunks(p_shop_id uuid, p_query_embedding vector, p_match_count integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, shop_id uuid, content text, source_file text, section text, source_kind text, priority smallint, chunk_index integer, knowledge_base_id uuid, document_id uuid, vector_score real)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  match_count INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_match_count, 20), 1), 50);
BEGIN
  IF p_shop_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'shop id is required';
  END IF;
  IF p_query_embedding IS NULL OR vector_dims(p_query_embedding) <> 768 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'query embedding must be 768 dimensions';
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    PERFORM set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true);
    PERFORM set_config('hnsw.ef_search', '100', true);
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.shop_id,
    c.content,
    c.source_file,
    c.section,
    c.source_kind,
    c.priority,
    c.chunk_index,
    c.knowledge_base_id,
    c.document_id,
    (1 - (c.embedding <=> p_query_embedding))::REAL AS vector_score
  FROM public.knowledge_chunks c
  WHERE c.shop_id = p_shop_id
    AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
    AND c.embedding_status = 'ready'
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> p_query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_shop_id uuid, p_query_embedding vector, p_match_count integer
functions.name: match_knowledge_chunks
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, shop_id uuid, content text, source_file text, section text, source_kind text, priority smallint, chunk_index integer, knowledge_base_id uuid, document_id uuid, vector_score real)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_shop_knowledge(query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer, p_shop_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title character varying, raw_content text, file_url text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  SELECT
    id,
    title,
    raw_content,
    file_url,
    1 - (embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM shop_knowledge
  WHERE shop_id = p_shop_id
  AND 1 - (embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_manual_payment(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text, p_admin_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_payment RECORD;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_payment
  FROM public.billing_payments
  WHERE id = p_payment_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment record % not found', p_payment_id;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.billing_payments
  SET status = 'rejected',
      rejected_reason = p_reason,
      slip_reference = NULL,
      verified_by = p_admin_id,
      verified_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_payment_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'payment_id', p_payment_id,
    'status', 'rejected',
    'reason', p_reason
  );
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text, p_admin_id uuid
functions.name: reject_manual_payment

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_knowledge_chunks_keyword(p_shop_id uuid, p_query text, p_match_count integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, shop_id uuid, content text, source_file text, section text, source_kind text, priority smallint, chunk_index integer, knowledge_base_id uuid, document_id uuid, keyword_score real)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  q TEXT := left(btrim(COALESCE(p_query, '')), 500);
  like_q TEXT;
  tsq tsquery;
  match_count INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_match_count, 20), 1), 50);
BEGIN
  IF p_shop_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'shop id is required';
  END IF;
  IF q = '' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  like_q := '%' || replace(replace(replace(q, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';

  BEGIN
    tsq := plainto_tsquery('simple', q);
    IF tsq IS NULL OR numnode(tsq) = 0 THEN
      tsq := NULL;
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    tsq := NULL;
  END;

  BEGIN
    PERFORM set_config('pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold', '0.35', true);
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.shop_id,
    c.content,
    c.source_file,
    c.section,
    c.source_kind,
    c.priority,
    c.chunk_index,
    c.knowledge_base_id,
    c.document_id,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN c.content ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\' THEN 1.0
        WHEN coalesce(c.section, '') ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\' THEN 0.85
        WHEN coalesce(c.source_file, '') ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\' THEN 0.7
        ELSE 0
      END
      + CASE WHEN tsq IS NOT NULL AND c.content_tsv @@ tsq THEN 0.35 ELSE 0 END
      + COALESCE(word_similarity(q, c.content), 0) * 0.5
      + COALESCE(word_similarity(q, coalesce(c.section, '')), 0) * 0.3
    )::REAL AS keyword_score
  FROM public.knowledge_chunks c
  WHERE c.shop_id = p_shop_id
    AND (
      c.content ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\'
      OR coalesce(c.section, '') ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\'
      OR coalesce(c.source_file, '') ILIKE like_q ESCAPE '\'
      OR (tsq IS NOT NULL AND c.content_tsv @@ tsq)
      OR q <% c.content
      OR q <% coalesce(c.section, '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM regexp_matches(q, '[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{2,}', 'g') AS token
        WHERE c.content ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(token[1], '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM regexp_matches(q, '\d{2,}', 'g') AS token
        WHERE c.content ILIKE '%' || token[1] || '%'
      )
    )
  ORDER BY keyword_score DESC, c.priority DESC, c.chunk_index ASC
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_shop_id uuid, p_query text, p_match_count integer
functions.name: search_knowledge_chunks_keyword
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, shop_id uuid, content text, source_file text, section text, source_kind text, priority smallint, chunk_index integer, knowledge_base_id uuid, document_id uuid, keyword_score real)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_manual_payment(p_plan_key text, p_billed_amount numeric, p_withheld_amount numeric, p_transferred_amount numeric, p_slip_url text, p_slip_reference text, p_customer_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_shop_id UUID;
  v_payment_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT workspace_id INTO v_shop_id 
  FROM public.users 
  WHERE id = auth.uid();

  IF v_shop_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: User does not belong to an active shop.';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.billing_payments (
    shop_id,
    provider,
    plan_key,
    amount,
    billed_amount,
    withheld_amount,
    transferred_amount,
    currency,
    status,
    slip_url,
    slip_reference,
    customer_notes,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_shop_id,
    'promptpay',
    p_plan_key,
    p_transferred_amount,
    p_billed_amount,
    COALESCE(p_withheld_amount, 0),
    p_transferred_amount,
    'THB',
    'pending',
    p_slip_url,
    p_slip_reference,
    p_customer_notes,
    now()
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_payment_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'payment_id', v_payment_id,
    'status', 'pending'
  );
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_plan_key text, p_billed_amount numeric, p_withheld_amount numeric, p_transferred_amount numeric, p_slip_url text, p_slip_reference text, p_customer_notes text
functions.name: submit_manual_payment
